t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The pairs for the gnomes are always the same, so orange and brown, red and yellow and so on. There are differences in the forests as well, so specific gnome colours will lead you to different forests. Orange, red and blue lead to a bright one, and brown, pink and yellow lead to a dark forest.

vb_textbox.text: Hi!There are fixed pairs for the gnomes, so orange and brown, green and pink etc. and they may change position, but the colour sets will remain fixed. Each colour of each pair will lead you to either to a light forest or a dark one and you need to figure out which colour leads you to the forest with more points. This can change, so keep track of which colour leads to which forest and which forest leads to more points.The colours of the gnomes matter, but their other physical characteristics do not.Good Luck!
